description: Help tied to a field, with an explanation and optional deeper detail.

howToUse: Use it as the label of a form field that needs an explanation: a tax term, a rule, a field people often get wrong.
Write `label` in the person's words and `helpText` in one or two sentences. Link the field with `htmlFor`.
When the topic needs more, use `onLearnMore` to open a Drawer with the full explanation.
alternatives: Help for the whole app: HelpMenu.
Telling what is wrong with the value: the `error` of the field.

keyboard.action: Focusing the help icon shows the explanation.

props.name: label
props.description: Plain field label (never the internal technical name).

props.name: helpText
props.description: Short explanation shown in the icon's rich help.

props.name: children
props.description: The field itself (Input, Select, Combobox…). Gets `aria-describedby` from the help text.

props.name: onLearnMore
props.description: "Learn more" link hook; the app opens the help Drawer (the component does not ship it).

examples.label: Playground
examples.description: Guide case: capacity allocation, a plain name + help, never a raw `share_pct`.

examples.label: Without "Learn more"
examples.description: Without `onLearnMore`: tooltip with text only (no link).

examples.label: With the app's Drawer
examples.description: Full integration: "Learn more" opens the APP's help Drawer (the Drawer is not part of HelpField).
